# Kill Chain v3.3.0

Fire Command sound character restored — remastered factory presets, wild coherent Natural Selection, richer timbre headroom, and sequencer/piano-roll clipping fixes.

## Highlights

- **Factory presets** remapped to real filter Q and category character (acid actually screams again)
- **Natural Selection** breeds coherent wild species instead of hot digital garbage
- **Sonic uniqueness** back: looser safety caps, stronger formants, Genesis character presets in the library
- **Sequencer / piano roll** gain staging so A+B+drums stop constantly slamming the soft-clipper

## Install

1. Download `Kill-Chain-Setup-3.3.0.exe` below
2. Run the installer
3. Launch **Kill Chain** from the Start menu

Windows may show SmartScreen — choose **More info** → **Run anyway** if you trust this build.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JerryKoller/Kill-Chain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
